market.question: Will the highest temperature in Madrid be 20°C on May 4?

assessment.reasoning: Madrid Barajas early-May highs ~20.9C; May 4 forecasted as the wettest day of the month, which can suppress highs. 20C bucket is plausibly the modal outcome.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether rain/clouds knock the high to 19C or sun pushes it to 21-22C.
